review:
A 6x3 avalanche game with a five-level Death Meter – every third avalanche unlocks a level, upgrading all of a chosen character symbol. xNudge wilds drop to the bottom of their reel, gaining +1 for every symbol they pass.

Line up three or more matching symbols horizontally without a win and Knock Knock triggers. xSplit shows up too, and the bonus is Ding Dong Spins. Extreme volatility, 14,280x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
